capabilities: Display the active ru/en layout as a colored badge at the caret
Convert selected text or the word at the caret to the other layout
Convert several preceding words on rapid repeated shortcut presses
Set separate badge colors for ru and en
Record and reset the layout-correction shortcut
disambiguation: Not related to the Cursor code editor or the mouse pointer; it shows the keyboard input layout at the text caret.
extras: Installed manually from release files rather than from the community list. On Linux the layout is read from niri, Fcitx 5, IBus/GNOME, Sway, Hyprland or X11 commands; if none is found the indicator stays hidden. A system Print Screen binding for screenshots must be removed or changed for the default Linux shortcut to work.
problem: Typing with the wrong keyboard layout silently produces garbled text, and Obsidian gives no sign of which layout is currently active.
summary: Caret-following badge that shows the active keyboard layout (ru or en) in the Markdown editor and converts words typed in the wrong layout.
